cases.name: utf-8; strict
cases.source:
import codecs
factory = codecs.getincrementaldecoder('utf-8')
data = '\ufeffAé😀\r\n\ufeffZ'.encode('utf-8')
for split in range(len(data) + 1):
    original = factory('strict')
    head = original.decode(data[:split])
    saved = original.getstate()
    clone = factory('strict')
    print('restore', split, clone.setstate(saved), clone.getstate(), head)
    try:
        print('final', repr(clone.decode(b'', True)))
    except UnicodeError as error:
        print('error', type(error).__name__, error.args, error.object, error.start, error.end, error.reason)
    print('after final', clone.getstate(), saved, original.getstate())
    clone.setstate(saved)
    tail = clone.decode(data[split:], True)
    print('tail', repr(tail), clone.getstate(), original.getstate())
    assert head + tail == '\ufeffAé😀\r\n\ufeffZ'
    assert original.getstate() == saved
    print('reset', clone.reset(), clone.getstate(), clone.decode(data, True))
    print('original', original.decode(data[split:], True), original.getstate())
encoder_factory = codecs.getincrementalencoder('utf-8')
encoder = encoder_factory('strict')
for text in ('', 'A', '\ufeff', '😀', ''):
    state = encoder.getstate()
    clone = encoder_factory('strict')
    print('encoder restore', state, clone.setstate(state))
    expected = encoder.encode(text, True)
    actual = clone.encode(text, True)
    assert actual == expected
    print('encoder', actual, encoder.getstate(), clone.getstate())
print('encoder reset', encoder.reset(), encoder.getstate(), encoder.encode('', True))

import codecs
factory = codecs.getincrementaldecoder('utf-8')
data = '\ufeffAé😀\r\n\ufeffZ'.encode('utf-8')
for split in range(len(data) + 1):
    original = factory('replace')
    head = original.decode(data[:split])
    saved = original.getstate()
    clone = factory('replace')
    print('restore', split, clone.setstate(saved), clone.getstate(), head)
    try:
        print('final', repr(clone.decode(b'', True)))
    except UnicodeError as error:
        print('error', type(error).__name__, error.args, error.object, error.start, error.end, error.reason)
    print('after final', clone.getstate(), saved, original.getstate())
    clone.setstate(saved)
    tail = clone.decode(data[split:], True)
    print('tail', repr(tail), clone.getstate(), original.getstate())
    assert head + tail == '\ufeffAé😀\r\n\ufeffZ'
    assert original.getstate() == saved
    print('reset', clone.reset(), clone.getstate(), clone.decode(data, True))
    print('original', original.decode(data[split:], True), original.getstate())
encoder_factory = codecs.getincrementalencoder('utf-8')
encoder = encoder_factory('replace')
for text in ('', 'A', '\ufeff', '😀', ''):
    state = encoder.getstate()
    clone = encoder_factory('replace')
    print('encoder restore', state, clone.setstate(state))
    expected = encoder.encode(text, True)
    actual = clone.encode(text, True)
    assert actual == expected
    print('encoder', actual, encoder.getstate(), clone.getstate())
print('encoder reset', encoder.reset(), encoder.getstate(), encoder.encode('', True))

cases.name: utf-8; surrogatepass
cases.source:
import codecs
factory = codecs.getincrementaldecoder('utf-8')
data = '\ufeffAé😀\r\n\ufeffZ'.encode('utf-8')
for split in range(len(data) + 1):
    original = factory('surrogatepass')
    head = original.decode(data[:split])
    saved = original.getstate()
    clone = factory('surrogatepass')
    print('restore', split, clone.setstate(saved), clone.getstate(), head)
    try:
        print('final', repr(clone.decode(b'', True)))
    except UnicodeError as error:
        print('error', type(error).__name__, error.args, error.object, error.start, error.end, error.reason)
    print('after final', clone.getstate(), saved, original.getstate())
    clone.setstate(saved)
    tail = clone.decode(data[split:], True)
    print('tail', repr(tail), clone.getstate(), original.getstate())
    assert head + tail == '\ufeffAé😀\r\n\ufeffZ'
    assert original.getstate() == saved
    print('reset', clone.reset(), clone.getstate(), clone.decode(data, True))
    print('original', original.decode(data[split:], True), original.getstate())
encoder_factory = codecs.getincrementalencoder('utf-8')
encoder = encoder_factory('surrogatepass')
for text in ('', 'A', '\ufeff', '😀', ''):
    state = encoder.getstate()
    clone = encoder_factory('surrogatepass')
    print('encoder restore', state, clone.setstate(state))
    expected = encoder.encode(text, True)
    actual = clone.encode(text, True)
    assert actual == expected
    print('encoder', actual, encoder.getstate(), clone.getstate())
print('encoder reset', encoder.reset(), encoder.getstate(), encoder.encode('', True))

cases.source:
import codecs
factory = codecs.getincrementaldecoder('utf-8-sig')
data = '\ufeffAé😀\r\n\ufeffZ'.encode('utf-8-sig')
for split in range(len(data) + 1):
    original = factory('replace')
    head = original.decode(data[:split])
    saved = original.getstate()
    clone = factory('replace')
    print('restore', split, clone.setstate(saved), clone.getstate(), head)
    try:
        print('final', repr(clone.decode(b'', True)))
    except UnicodeError as error:
        print('error', type(error).__name__, error.args, error.object, error.start, error.end, error.reason)
    print('after final', clone.getstate(), saved, original.getstate())
    clone.setstate(saved)
    tail = clone.decode(data[split:], True)
    print('tail', repr(tail), clone.getstate(), original.getstate())
    assert head + tail == '\ufeffAé😀\r\n\ufeffZ'
    assert original.getstate() == saved
    print('reset', clone.reset(), clone.getstate(), clone.decode(data, True))
    print('original', original.decode(data[split:], True), original.getstate())
encoder_factory = codecs.getincrementalencoder('utf-8-sig')
encoder = encoder_factory('replace')
for text in ('', 'A', '\ufeff', '😀', ''):
    state = encoder.getstate()
    clone = encoder_factory('replace')
    print('encoder restore', state, clone.setstate(state))
    expected = encoder.encode(text, True)
    actual = clone.encode(text, True)
    assert actual == expected
    print('encoder', actual, encoder.getstate(), clone.getstate())
print('encoder reset', encoder.reset(), encoder.getstate(), encoder.encode('', True))

cases.name: utf-8-sig; surrogatepass
cases.source:
import codecs
factory = codecs.getincrementaldecoder('utf-8-sig')
data = '\ufeffAé😀\r\n\ufeffZ'.encode('utf-8-sig')
for split in range(len(data) + 1):
    original = factory('surrogatepass')
    head = original.decode(data[:split])
    saved = original.getstate()
    clone = factory('surrogatepass')
    print('restore', split, clone.setstate(saved), clone.getstate(), head)
    try:
        print('final', repr(clone.decode(b'', True)))
    except UnicodeError as error:
        print('error', type(error).__name__, error.args, error.object, error.start, error.end, error.reason)
    print('after final', clone.getstate(), saved, original.getstate())
    clone.setstate(saved)
    tail = clone.decode(data[split:], True)
    print('tail', repr(tail), clone.getstate(), original.getstate())
    assert head + tail == '\ufeffAé😀\r\n\ufeffZ'
    assert original.getstate() == saved
    print('reset', clone.reset(), clone.getstate(), clone.decode(data, True))
    print('original', original.decode(data[split:], True), original.getstate())
encoder_factory = codecs.getincrementalencoder('utf-8-sig')
encoder = encoder_factory('surrogatepass')
for text in ('', 'A', '\ufeff', '😀', ''):
    state = encoder.getstate()
    clone = encoder_factory('surrogatepass')
    print('encoder restore', state, clone.setstate(state))
    expected = encoder.encode(text, True)
    actual = clone.encode(text, True)
    assert actual == expected
    print('encoder', actual, encoder.getstate(), clone.getstate())
print('encoder reset', encoder.reset(), encoder.getstate(), encoder.encode('', True))

cases.name: utf-7; replace
cases.source:
import codecs
factory = codecs.getincrementaldecoder('utf-7')
data = '\ufeffAé😀\r\n\ufeffZ'.encode('utf-7')
for split in range(len(data) + 1):
    original = factory('replace')
    head = original.decode(data[:split])
    saved = original.getstate()
    clone = factory('replace')
    print('restore', split, clone.setstate(saved), clone.getstate(), head)
    try:
        print('final', repr(clone.decode(b'', True)))
    except UnicodeError as error:
        print('error', type(error).__name__, error.args, error.object, error.start, error.end, error.reason)
    print('after final', clone.getstate(), saved, original.getstate())
    clone.setstate(saved)
    tail = clone.decode(data[split:], True)
    print('tail', repr(tail), clone.getstate(), original.getstate())
    assert head + tail == '\ufeffAé😀\r\n\ufeffZ'
    assert original.getstate() == saved
    print('reset', clone.reset(), clone.getstate(), clone.decode(data, True))
    print('original', original.decode(data[split:], True), original.getstate())
encoder_factory = codecs.getincrementalencoder('utf-7')
encoder = encoder_factory('replace')
for text in ('', 'A', '\ufeff', '😀', ''):
    state = encoder.getstate()
    clone = encoder_factory('replace')
    print('encoder restore', state, clone.setstate(state))
    expected = encoder.encode(text, True)
    actual = clone.encode(text, True)
    assert actual == expected
    print('encoder', actual, encoder.getstate(), clone.getstate())
print('encoder reset', encoder.reset(), encoder.getstate(), encoder.encode('', True))

cases.name: utf-7; surrogatepass
cases.source:
import codecs
factory = codecs.getincrementaldecoder('utf-7')
data = '\ufeffAé😀\r\n\ufeffZ'.encode('utf-7')
for split in range(len(data) + 1):
    original = factory('surrogatepass')
    head = original.decode(data[:split])
    saved = original.getstate()
    clone = factory('surrogatepass')
    print('restore', split, clone.setstate(saved), clone.getstate(), head)
    try:
        print('final', repr(clone.decode(b'', True)))
    except UnicodeError as error:
        print('error', type(error).__name__, error.args, error.object, error.start, error.end, error.reason)
    print('after final', clone.getstate(), saved, original.getstate())
    clone.setstate(saved)
    tail = clone.decode(data[split:], True)
    print('tail', repr(tail), clone.getstate(), original.getstate())
    assert head + tail == '\ufeffAé😀\r\n\ufeffZ'
    assert original.getstate() == saved
    print('reset', clone.reset(), clone.getstate(), clone.decode(data, True))
    print('original', original.decode(data[split:], True), original.getstate())
encoder_factory = codecs.getincrementalencoder('utf-7')
encoder = encoder_factory('surrogatepass')
for text in ('', 'A', '\ufeff', '😀', ''):
    state = encoder.getstate()
    clone = encoder_factory('surrogatepass')
    print('encoder restore', state, clone.setstate(state))
    expected = encoder.encode(text, True)
    actual = clone.encode(text, True)
    assert actual == expected
    print('encoder', actual, encoder.getstate(), clone.getstate())
print('encoder reset', encoder.reset(), encoder.getstate(), encoder.encode('', True))

cases.source:
import codecs
factory = codecs.getincrementaldecoder('utf-16-le')
data = '\ufeffAé😀\r\n\ufeffZ'.encode('utf-16-le')
for split in range(len(data) + 1):
    original = factory('strict')
    head = original.decode(data[:split])
    saved = original.getstate()
    clone = factory('strict')
    print('restore', split, clone.setstate(saved), clone.getstate(), head)
    try:
        print('final', repr(clone.decode(b'', True)))
    except UnicodeError as error:
        print('error', type(error).__name__, error.args, error.object, error.start, error.end, error.reason)
    print('after final', clone.getstate(), saved, original.getstate())
    clone.setstate(saved)
    tail = clone.decode(data[split:], True)
    print('tail', repr(tail), clone.getstate(), original.getstate())
    assert head + tail == '\ufeffAé😀\r\n\ufeffZ'
    assert original.getstate() == saved
    print('reset', clone.reset(), clone.getstate(), clone.decode(data, True))
    print('original', original.decode(data[split:], True), original.getstate())
encoder_factory = codecs.getincrementalencoder('utf-16-le')
encoder = encoder_factory('strict')
for text in ('', 'A', '\ufeff', '😀', ''):
    state = encoder.getstate()
    clone = encoder_factory('strict')
    print('encoder restore', state, clone.setstate(state))
    expected = encoder.encode(text, True)
    actual = clone.encode(text, True)
    assert actual == expected
    print('encoder', actual, encoder.getstate(), clone.getstate())
print('encoder reset', encoder.reset(), encoder.getstate(), encoder.encode('', True))

cases.name: utf-16-le; replace
cases.source:
import codecs
factory = codecs.getincrementaldecoder('utf-16-le')
data = '\ufeffAé😀\r\n\ufeffZ'.encode('utf-16-le')
for split in range(len(data) + 1):
    original = factory('replace')
    head = original.decode(data[:split])
    saved = original.getstate()
    clone = factory('replace')
    print('restore', split, clone.setstate(saved), clone.getstate(), head)
    try:
        print('final', repr(clone.decode(b'', True)))
    except UnicodeError as error:
        print('error', type(error).__name__, error.args, error.object, error.start, error.end, error.reason)
    print('after final', clone.getstate(), saved, original.getstate())
    clone.setstate(saved)
    tail = clone.decode(data[split:], True)
    print('tail', repr(tail), clone.getstate(), original.getstate())
    assert head + tail == '\ufeffAé😀\r\n\ufeffZ'
    assert original.getstate() == saved
    print('reset', clone.reset(), clone.getstate(), clone.decode(data, True))
    print('original', original.decode(data[split:], True), original.getstate())
encoder_factory = codecs.getincrementalencoder('utf-16-le')
encoder = encoder_factory('replace')
for text in ('', 'A', '\ufeff', '😀', ''):
    state = encoder.getstate()
    clone = encoder_factory('replace')
    print('encoder restore', state, clone.setstate(state))
    expected = encoder.encode(text, True)
    actual = clone.encode(text, True)
    assert actual == expected
    print('encoder', actual, encoder.getstate(), clone.getstate())
print('encoder reset', encoder.reset(), encoder.getstate(), encoder.encode('', True))

cases.name: utf-16-be; strict
cases.source:
import codecs
factory = codecs.getincrementaldecoder('utf-16-be')
data = '\ufeffAé😀\r\n\ufeffZ'.encode('utf-16-be')
for split in range(len(data) + 1):
    original = factory('strict')
    head = original.decode(data[:split])
    saved = original.getstate()
    clone = factory('strict')
    print('restore', split, clone.setstate(saved), clone.getstate(), head)
    try:
        print('final', repr(clone.decode(b'', True)))
    except UnicodeError as error:
        print('error', type(error).__name__, error.args, error.object, error.start, error.end, error.reason)
    print('after final', clone.getstate(), saved, original.getstate())
    clone.setstate(saved)
    tail = clone.decode(data[split:], True)
    print('tail', repr(tail), clone.getstate(), original.getstate())
    assert head + tail == '\ufeffAé😀\r\n\ufeffZ'
    assert original.getstate() == saved
    print('reset', clone.reset(), clone.getstate(), clone.decode(data, True))
    print('original', original.decode(data[split:], True), original.getstate())
encoder_factory = codecs.getincrementalencoder('utf-16-be')
encoder = encoder_factory('strict')
for text in ('', 'A', '\ufeff', '😀', ''):
    state = encoder.getstate()
    clone = encoder_factory('strict')
    print('encoder restore', state, clone.setstate(state))
    expected = encoder.encode(text, True)
    actual = clone.encode(text, True)
    assert actual == expected
    print('encoder', actual, encoder.getstate(), clone.getstate())
print('encoder reset', encoder.reset(), encoder.getstate(), encoder.encode('', True))

cases.name: utf-16-be; surrogatepass
cases.source:
import codecs
factory = codecs.getincrementaldecoder('utf-16-be')
data = '\ufeffAé😀\r\n\ufeffZ'.encode('utf-16-be')
for split in range(len(data) + 1):
    original = factory('surrogatepass')
    head = original.decode(data[:split])
    saved = original.getstate()
    clone = factory('surrogatepass')
    print('restore', split, clone.setstate(saved), clone.getstate(), head)
    try:
        print('final', repr(clone.decode(b'', True)))
    except UnicodeError as error:
        print('error', type(error).__name__, error.args, error.object, error.start, error.end, error.reason)
    print('after final', clone.getstate(), saved, original.getstate())
    clone.setstate(saved)
    tail = clone.decode(data[split:], True)
    print('tail', repr(tail), clone.getstate(), original.getstate())
    assert head + tail == '\ufeffAé😀\r\n\ufeffZ'
    assert original.getstate() == saved
    print('reset', clone.reset(), clone.getstate(), clone.decode(data, True))
    print('original', original.decode(data[split:], True), original.getstate())
encoder_factory = codecs.getincrementalencoder('utf-16-be')
encoder = encoder_factory('surrogatepass')
for text in ('', 'A', '\ufeff', '😀', ''):
    state = encoder.getstate()
    clone = encoder_factory('surrogatepass')
    print('encoder restore', state, clone.setstate(state))
    expected = encoder.encode(text, True)
    actual = clone.encode(text, True)
    assert actual == expected
    print('encoder', actual, encoder.getstate(), clone.getstate())
print('encoder reset', encoder.reset(), encoder.getstate(), encoder.encode('', True))

cases.name: utf-32-le; strict
cases.source:
import codecs
factory = codecs.getincrementaldecoder('utf-32-le')
data = '\ufeffAé😀\r\n\ufeffZ'.encode('utf-32-le')
for split in range(len(data) + 1):
    original = factory('strict')
    head = original.decode(data[:split])
    saved = original.getstate()
    clone = factory('strict')
    print('restore', split, clone.setstate(saved), clone.getstate(), head)
    try:
        print('final', repr(clone.decode(b'', True)))
    except UnicodeError as error:
        print('error', type(error).__name__, error.args, error.object, error.start, error.end, error.reason)
    print('after final', clone.getstate(), saved, original.getstate())
    clone.setstate(saved)
    tail = clone.decode(data[split:], True)
    print('tail', repr(tail), clone.getstate(), original.getstate())
    assert head + tail == '\ufeffAé😀\r\n\ufeffZ'
    assert original.getstate() == saved
    print('reset', clone.reset(), clone.getstate(), clone.decode(data, True))
    print('original', original.decode(data[split:], True), original.getstate())
encoder_factory = codecs.getincrementalencoder('utf-32-le')
encoder = encoder_factory('strict')
for text in ('', 'A', '\ufeff', '😀', ''):
    state = encoder.getstate()
    clone = encoder_factory('strict')
    print('encoder restore', state, clone.setstate(state))
    expected = encoder.encode(text, True)
    actual = clone.encode(text, True)
    assert actual == expected
    print('encoder', actual, encoder.getstate(), clone.getstate())
print('encoder reset', encoder.reset(), encoder.getstate(), encoder.encode('', True))

cases.name: utf-32-le; replace
cases.source:
import codecs
factory = codecs.getincrementaldecoder('utf-32-le')
data = '\ufeffAé😀\r\n\ufeffZ'.encode('utf-32-le')
for split in range(len(data) + 1):
    original = factory('replace')
    head = original.decode(data[:split])
    saved = original.getstate()
    clone = factory('replace')
    print('restore', split, clone.setstate(saved), clone.getstate(), head)
    try:
        print('final', repr(clone.decode(b'', True)))
    except UnicodeError as error:
        print('error', type(error).__name__, error.args, error.object, error.start, error.end, error.reason)
    print('after final', clone.getstate(), saved, original.getstate())
    clone.setstate(saved)
    tail = clone.decode(data[split:], True)
    print('tail', repr(tail), clone.getstate(), original.getstate())
    assert head + tail == '\ufeffAé😀\r\n\ufeffZ'
    assert original.getstate() == saved
    print('reset', clone.reset(), clone.getstate(), clone.decode(data, True))
    print('original', original.decode(data[split:], True), original.getstate())
encoder_factory = codecs.getincrementalencoder('utf-32-le')
encoder = encoder_factory('replace')
for text in ('', 'A', '\ufeff', '😀', ''):
    state = encoder.getstate()
    clone = encoder_factory('replace')
    print('encoder restore', state, clone.setstate(state))
    expected = encoder.encode(text, True)
    actual = clone.encode(text, True)
    assert actual == expected
    print('encoder', actual, encoder.getstate(), clone.getstate())
print('encoder reset', encoder.reset(), encoder.getstate(), encoder.encode('', True))

cases.name: utf-32-le; surrogatepass
cases.source:
import codecs
factory = codecs.getincrementaldecoder('utf-32-le')
data = '\ufeffAé😀\r\n\ufeffZ'.encode('utf-32-le')
for split in range(len(data) + 1):
    original = factory('surrogatepass')
    head = original.decode(data[:split])
    saved = original.getstate()
    clone = factory('surrogatepass')
    print('restore', split, clone.setstate(saved), clone.getstate(), head)
    try:
        print('final', repr(clone.decode(b'', True)))
    except UnicodeError as error:
        print('error', type(error).__name__, error.args, error.object, error.start, error.end, error.reason)
    print('after final', clone.getstate(), saved, original.getstate())
    clone.setstate(saved)
    tail = clone.decode(data[split:], True)
    print('tail', repr(tail), clone.getstate(), original.getstate())
    assert head + tail == '\ufeffAé😀\r\n\ufeffZ'
    assert original.getstate() == saved
    print('reset', clone.reset(), clone.getstate(), clone.decode(data, True))
    print('original', original.decode(data[split:], True), original.getstate())
encoder_factory = codecs.getincrementalencoder('utf-32-le')
encoder = encoder_factory('surrogatepass')
for text in ('', 'A', '\ufeff', '😀', ''):
    state = encoder.getstate()
    clone = encoder_factory('surrogatepass')
    print('encoder restore', state, clone.setstate(state))
    expected = encoder.encode(text, True)
    actual = clone.encode(text, True)
    assert actual == expected
    print('encoder', actual, encoder.getstate(), clone.getstate())
print('encoder reset', encoder.reset(), encoder.getstate(), encoder.encode('', True))

cases.name: utf-32-be; strict
cases.source:
import codecs
factory = codecs.getincrementaldecoder('utf-32-be')
data = '\ufeffAé😀\r\n\ufeffZ'.encode('utf-32-be')
for split in range(len(data) + 1):
    original = factory('strict')
    head = original.decode(data[:split])
    saved = original.getstate()
    clone = factory('strict')
    print('restore', split, clone.setstate(saved), clone.getstate(), head)
    try:
        print('final', repr(clone.decode(b'', True)))
    except UnicodeError as error:
        print('error', type(error).__name__, error.args, error.object, error.start, error.end, error.reason)
    print('after final', clone.getstate(), saved, original.getstate())
    clone.setstate(saved)
    tail = clone.decode(data[split:], True)
    print('tail', repr(tail), clone.getstate(), original.getstate())
    assert head + tail == '\ufeffAé😀\r\n\ufeffZ'
    assert original.getstate() == saved
    print('reset', clone.reset(), clone.getstate(), clone.decode(data, True))
    print('original', original.decode(data[split:], True), original.getstate())
encoder_factory = codecs.getincrementalencoder('utf-32-be')
encoder = encoder_factory('strict')
for text in ('', 'A', '\ufeff', '😀', ''):
    state = encoder.getstate()
    clone = encoder_factory('strict')
    print('encoder restore', state, clone.setstate(state))
    expected = encoder.encode(text, True)
    actual = clone.encode(text, True)
    assert actual == expected
    print('encoder', actual, encoder.getstate(), clone.getstate())
print('encoder reset', encoder.reset(), encoder.getstate(), encoder.encode('', True))

cases.name: utf-32-be; replace
cases.source:
import codecs
factory = codecs.getincrementaldecoder('utf-32-be')
data = '\ufeffAé😀\r\n\ufeffZ'.encode('utf-32-be')
for split in range(len(data) + 1):
    original = factory('replace')
    head = original.decode(data[:split])
    saved = original.getstate()
    clone = factory('replace')
    print('restore', split, clone.setstate(saved), clone.getstate(), head)
    try:
        print('final', repr(clone.decode(b'', True)))
    except UnicodeError as error:
        print('error', type(error).__name__, error.args, error.object, error.start, error.end, error.reason)
    print('after final', clone.getstate(), saved, original.getstate())
    clone.setstate(saved)
    tail = clone.decode(data[split:], True)
    print('tail', repr(tail), clone.getstate(), original.getstate())
    assert head + tail == '\ufeffAé😀\r\n\ufeffZ'
    assert original.getstate() == saved
    print('reset', clone.reset(), clone.getstate(), clone.decode(data, True))
    print('original', original.decode(data[split:], True), original.getstate())
encoder_factory = codecs.getincrementalencoder('utf-32-be')
encoder = encoder_factory('replace')
for text in ('', 'A', '\ufeff', '😀', ''):
    state = encoder.getstate()
    clone = encoder_factory('replace')
    print('encoder restore', state, clone.setstate(state))
    expected = encoder.encode(text, True)
    actual = clone.encode(text, True)
    assert actual == expected
    print('encoder', actual, encoder.getstate(), clone.getstate())
print('encoder reset', encoder.reset(), encoder.getstate(), encoder.encode('', True))

cases.name: utf-32-be; surrogatepass
cases.source:
import codecs
factory = codecs.getincrementaldecoder('utf-32-be')
data = '\ufeffAé😀\r\n\ufeffZ'.encode('utf-32-be')
for split in range(len(data) + 1):
    original = factory('surrogatepass')
    head = original.decode(data[:split])
    saved = original.getstate()
    clone = factory('surrogatepass')
    print('restore', split, clone.setstate(saved), clone.getstate(), head)
    try:
        print('final', repr(clone.decode(b'', True)))
    except UnicodeError as error:
        print('error', type(error).__name__, error.args, error.object, error.start, error.end, error.reason)
    print('after final', clone.getstate(), saved, original.getstate())
    clone.setstate(saved)
    tail = clone.decode(data[split:], True)
    print('tail', repr(tail), clone.getstate(), original.getstate())
    assert head + tail == '\ufeffAé😀\r\n\ufeffZ'
    assert original.getstate() == saved
    print('reset', clone.reset(), clone.getstate(), clone.decode(data, True))
    print('original', original.decode(data[split:], True), original.getstate())
encoder_factory = codecs.getincrementalencoder('utf-32-be')
encoder = encoder_factory('surrogatepass')
for text in ('', 'A', '\ufeff', '😀', ''):
    state = encoder.getstate()
    clone = encoder_factory('surrogatepass')
    print('encoder restore', state, clone.setstate(state))
    expected = encoder.encode(text, True)
    actual = clone.encode(text, True)
    assert actual == expected
    print('encoder', actual, encoder.getstate(), clone.getstate())
print('encoder reset', encoder.reset(), encoder.getstate(), encoder.encode('', True))

cases.name: utf-16 registry and module API
cases.source:
import codecs
import encodings.utf_16 as module
name = 'utf-16'
unit = 2
little = 'utf_16_le'
big = 'utf_16_be'
bom = codecs.BOM_UTF16_LE
text = 'Aé🐍'
data = bom + text.encode(little)

info = codecs.lookup(name)
alias = codecs.lookup('u16')
assert alias is codecs.lookup('u16') and alias is not info
assert alias.name == info.name and alias.encode is info.encode
assert alias.decode is info.decode
assert type(info) is codecs.CodecInfo
assert info.name == name
assert info.encode is module.encode is getattr(codecs, 'utf_16_encode')
assert info.decode is module.decode
assert info.incrementalencoder is module.IncrementalEncoder
assert info.incrementaldecoder is module.IncrementalDecoder
assert info.streamreader is module.StreamReader
assert info.streamwriter is module.StreamWriter
assert module.getregentry() is not info
assert module.encode(text) == (data, len(text))
assert module.decode(data) == (text, len(data))
assert module.decode(text.encode(little)) == (text, len(data) - unit)
assert codecs.encode(text, name) == data
assert codecs.decode(data, name) == text
assert bytes(text, name) == data

import codecs
import encodings.utf_16 as module
name = 'utf-16'
unit = 2
little = 'utf_16_le'
big = 'utf_16_be'
bom = codecs.BOM_UTF16_LE
text = 'Aé🐍'
data = bom + text.encode(little)

encoder = module.IncrementalEncoder()
assert encoder.errors == 'strict' and encoder.encoder is None
assert encoder.getstate() == 2
try:
    encoder.encode('\ud800')
except UnicodeEncodeError as error:
    assert (error.encoding, error.object, error.start, error.end, error.reason) == (name, '\ud800', 0, 1, 'surrogates not allowed')
else:
    assert False
assert encoder.getstate() == 2 and encoder.encoder is None
assert encoder.encode('') == bom
assert encoder.getstate() == 0
assert encoder.encode(text, True) == text.encode(little)
assert encoder.encode('', True) == b''
encoder.reset()
assert encoder.getstate() == 2 and encoder.encode(text) == data
for state in (0, False, [], 1, 2, -1, [0]):
    encoder.setstate(state)
    assert encoder.getstate() == (2 if state else 0)
    assert encoder.encode(text) == (data if state else text.encode(little))

cases.name: utf-16 every incremental split and state restoration
cases.source:
import codecs
import encodings.utf_16 as module
name = 'utf-16'
unit = 2
little = 'utf_16_le'
big = 'utf_16_be'
bom = codecs.BOM_UTF16_LE
text = 'Aé🐍'
data = bom + text.encode(little)

for byteorder, flag in ((little, 0), (big, 1)):
    prefix = bom if flag == 0 else getattr(codecs, 'BOM_UTF16_BE')
    encoded = prefix + text.encode(byteorder)
    for split in range(len(encoded) + 1):
        decoder = module.IncrementalDecoder()
        assert decoder.getstate() == (b'', 2)
        first = decoder.decode(encoded[:split])
        state = decoder.getstate()
        assert state[1] == (2 if split < unit else flag)
        restored = module.IncrementalDecoder()
        restored.setstate(state)
        assert restored.getstate() == state
        assert first + decoder.decode(encoded[split:], True) == text
        assert first + restored.decode(encoded[split:], True) == text
        decoder.reset()
        assert decoder.getstate() == (b'', 2) and decoder.decoder is None
        assert decoder.decode(data, True) == text
for state, byteorder in ((0, little), (1, big)):
    decoder = module.IncrementalDecoder()
    decoder.setstate((b'', state))
    assert decoder.decode(text.encode(byteorder), True) == text

cases.source:
import codecs
import encodings.utf_16 as module
name = 'utf-16'
unit = 2
little = 'utf_16_le'
big = 'utf_16_be'
bom = codecs.BOM_UTF16_LE
text = 'Aé🐍'
data = bom + text.encode(little)

for errors in ('strict', 'ignore', 'replace'):
    decoder = module.IncrementalDecoder(errors)
    raw = 'A'.encode(little)
    try:
        decoder.decode(raw, True)
    except UnicodeDecodeError as error:
        assert error.args == (name, raw, 0, unit, 'Stream does not start with BOM')
        assert error.object is raw
    else:
        assert False
    assert decoder.getstate() == (b'', 2)
    assert decoder.decode(data, True) == text
decoder = module.IncrementalDecoder()
assert decoder.decode(bom[:1]) == ''
assert decoder.getstate() == (bom[:1], 2)
try:
    decoder.decode(b'', True)
except UnicodeDecodeError as error:
    assert (error.object, error.start, error.end, error.reason) == (bom[:1], 0, 1, 'truncated data')
else:
    assert False
assert decoder.getstate() == (bom[:1], 2)
assert decoder.decode(data[1:], True) == text

cases.name: utf-16 stream adapters BOM and reset
cases.source:
import codecs
import encodings.utf_16 as module
name = 'utf-16'
unit = 2
little = 'utf_16_le'
big = 'utf_16_be'
bom = codecs.BOM_UTF16_LE
text = 'Aé🐍'
data = bom + text.encode(little)

class Stream:
    def __init__(self, data=b''):
        self.data = data
    def write(self, data):
        self.data += data
    def read(self, size=-1):
        if size < 0:
            size = len(self.data)
        result = self.data[:size]
        self.data = self.data[size:]
        return result
stream = Stream()
writer = codecs.getwriter(name)(stream)
assert writer.encoder is None
writer.write('')
writer.write(text)
writer.write('')
assert stream.data == data
writer.reset()
assert writer.encoder is None
writer.write(text)
assert stream.data == data + data
reader = codecs.getreader(name)(Stream(data))
assert reader.read(1) + reader.read() == text
assert reader.decode is getattr(codecs, little + '_decode')
reader.reset()
assert 'decode' not in reader.__dict__
assert reader.decode(data) == (text, len(data))
reader.reset()
raw = 'A'.encode(little)
try:
    reader.decode(raw)
except UnicodeDecodeError as error:
    assert error.args == (name, raw, 0, unit, 'Stream does not start with BOM')
else:
    assert False
assert 'decode' not in reader.__dict__
